verdict.rationale: Rippling ships embedded AI features, such as AI-built reports and employee Q&A, so letting that AI use tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows MCP client support. The app integrations, developer kits and CLI are traditional integration building blocks, not MCP server plug-in support, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
